definition.label: Joint price movement, within-order structure and capacity
definition.formula: V25 original18-input quadratic offset design plus standardized signedlog linear inputs ip_price_comparable_categories,ip_multicat_price_orders180,ip_valid_price_items180,ip_price_change_observed,ip_order_coherence_observed,ip_affordability_cross_observed,ip_debt_cross_observed,ip_liquidity_cross_observed,ip_category_price_change_shrunk,ip_category_price_change_breadth,ip_category_price_change_dispersion,ip_within_order_price_covariance_shrunk,ip_within_order_price_dispersion,ip_price_upgrade_x_installment_burden,ip_order_covariance_x_total_burden,ip_price_dispersion_x_liquidity_shortfall; all new value-availability masks are explicit shared support features. Fit meanBCE(KumoLogit+Xbeta)+.003/2||base_beta_nonintercept||^2+.01/2||new_beta||^2 on identical6k; new means/scales fit only6k; undefined additional values contribute0 in centered basis and retainNaN in raw cache; inference eta=KumoLogit+.5Xbeta; final75:25original_spline77; mean5foldtest.
definition.rationale: Audit found weak spectral values, duplicated missing indicators and thin-file errors. Test price_change,order_coherence,cross_capacity beyond exactly the same8 support/availability variables. Own-category prices remove category-level composition without a population reference; cross-category within-order covariance measures a different structure than category entropy or mean price. No SKU/quality information; estimates are finite-history proxies and raw price changes are not causal risk evidence. New inputs are linear with stronger shrinkage to avoid repeating the145-parameter spectral head; repeated development selection remains.

definition.label: Fixed V25 with orthogonalized item-history support
definition.formula: Keep the original V25 head beta0 fixed. On identical6k correction rows fit signedlog standardization for U; missing values are0 in centered basis with explicit shared support flags. Fit A=lstsq(Xbase,U,rcond=1e-6); R=U-Xbase*A. Do not rescale residuals. eta0=logit(frozenKumo)+.5*Xbase*beta0. Fit gamma minimizing meanBCE(eta0+R*gamma)+.01/2||gamma||^2. Inference eta=eta0+.25*R*gamma; final=.75sigmoid(eta)+.25original_spline77; mean5fold test. Projection is training-only; query targets are unused.
definition.rationale: V243 shared coverage-only augmentation lowered KS to0.52934705 and AUC to0.84692008, although counts have strong marginal risk associations. V25 already includes observation depth and posterior uncertainty. Preserve its learned correction; test residual information without refitting its90 coefficients. V251 is the matched support control, V252 adds value information, V253 diagnoses the projection choice. Coefficients use the same6k as the original head, so training optimism and repeated development selection remain; no improvement is assumed.
